actual_price_of_fairness.definition: actual_robust_cost / baseline_cost - 1, recomputed by exact post-evaluation.
actual_price_of_fairness.label: Actual price of fairness

actual_robust_cost.definition: First-stage cost plus the maximum recourse cost over all exact post-evaluation scenarios.
actual_robust_cost.label: Post-evaluation robust cost

algorithm_runtime.definition: Optimization algorithm runtime only; excludes post-evaluation.
algorithm_runtime.label: Algorithm runtime

cut_count.definition: Final number of append-only certified Farkas cuts.
cut_count.label: Certified Farkas cuts

minimum_weighted_mean_fill_rate.definition: Post-evaluation min_s [1 - total_shortage_s / total_demand_s]; a system-wide demand-weighted mean within each scenario, not the minimum regional fill rate.
minimum_weighted_mean_fill_rate.label: Worst-scenario demand-weighted mean regional fill rate

objective_t.definition: Final certified objective T; an upper bound on shortage/demand for every applicable region under every scenario in the exact uncertainty set.
objective_t.label: Certified robust worst-region shortage rate (T)

penalized_runtime_par2.definition: Algorithm runtime for certified tasks; 3600 seconds for an uncertified task under the frozen PAR-2 rule.
penalized_runtime_par2.label: PAR-2 algorithm runtime

post_evaluation_wall_runtime.definition: Exact post-evaluation pipeline wall time only.
post_evaluation_wall_runtime.label: Post-evaluation wall time

robust_minimum_fill_rate.definition: Algorithm certificate 1 - objective_t; a guaranteed lower bound for every applicable region under every scenario, not a demand-weighted mean.
robust_minimum_fill_rate.label: Certified robust minimum regional fill-rate guarantee (1 - T)

scenario_count.definition: Final number of complete scenario recourse blocks committed to the master.
scenario_count.label: Committed master scenario blocks

total_wall_runtime.definition: Recorded end-to-end wall time, reported separately from algorithm and post-evaluation runtimes.
total_wall_runtime.label: Total wall time

wgap.definition: Post-evaluation max_s [max_r fill_rate_(s,r) - min_r fill_rate_(s,r)] over applicable regions.
wgap.label: Post-evaluation worst fill-rate range

wminfr.definition: Post-evaluation min_s min_r fill_rate_(s,r) over applicable regions and all exact scenarios.
wminfr.label: Post-evaluation worst-scenario minimum regional fill rate

wwd.definition: Post-evaluation max_s max_r [weighted_mean_fill_rate_s - fill_rate_(s,r)] over applicable regions.
wwd.label: Post-evaluation worst regional deviation below weighted mean
